utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I have some tools we could use.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, thanks for thinking of me. What time are people gathering?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're planning to start around 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Repair drive? Can you tell me more about what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a shared drive for neighborhood repair tools. We need someone to sort and inventory the items.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, I'm checking our supply list for the repair drive. Do we need anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, repair drive? Right, that thing. Did we say we needed duct tape or something?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, duct tape is on the list, along with some extra screws and a hammer. Can you grab those?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, did you need a hand with the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Rey, yes, I could use a hand. But I'm a bit worried about the timing—do you have enough time to help me figure this out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I've got some time this afternoon. What's the issue?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of repairs does the drive need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm not entirely sure. I just heard from someone that the drive needs some work, but I don't have the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who told you that?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard! I've got a bunch of tools I can bring, anything you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that'd be great! My porch chair's got a wobbly leg, if you've got a wrench handy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Definitely, I'll be there! But where exactly is it being held?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 10 AM. Can't wait to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you're organizing the repair drive. How can I help out?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you actually volunteering? I mean, no offense, but I've never seen you touch a tool before.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I know, I know, but I'm a quick learner. Just tell me what needs fixing and point me in the right direction.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo! I was hoping to catch you — how are things going with the repair drive sign-ups?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Rosa! Yeah, the sign-ups are going okay, I think. I've been pretty swamped, but I'll check the list later.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries at all, Bo! I know you're busy. If you need a hand sorting through the list, just let me know — I'm happy to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, are you heading to the repair drive this weekend? I heard they're fixing bikes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Repair drive? What time on Saturday? I like to have my schedule set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's at 10 AM on Saturday, don't forget to bring your bike!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Uli, I'm sorry, but I completely forgot what we're repairing. Could you remind me again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's the old fence at the end of the lane.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right! The fence. So what's the plan? Do we need to replace a few boards or something?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, how's the repair drive coming along? Need any extra tools or hands?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, thanks Jules! I think we're good on tools for now, but extra hands are always welcome.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll drop by after lunch. Just let me know if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! We're organizing a repair drive this weekend to fix up the community garden tools. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds like a plan! I might be a bit late, but count me in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, glad to have you! Even a little late is fine—we'll save a rake for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Repair drive? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's a community effort to fix up the neighborhood—like repairing fences, painting park benches, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds nice. When does it start?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mara, how's the planning for the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's coming along nicely! We've got a good list of volunteers for the day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great to hear! Have you set a date yet? I can help coordinate with the school calendar so we don't conflict with any events.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I heard you were working on that repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm helping organize it! We're planning to fix up the community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome! I know a few people who might want to help out too. Want me to spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools if anyone needs to borrow them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's nice of you Gus, but who's going to keep track of all those tools? We need a proper sign-out sheet or something.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can make a simple sign-out sheet on a clipboard, no problem.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Rosa, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Opal! We're all set for Saturday morning. I've got the sign-up sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great! Do we have a central meeting spot picked out or should I just head to your place?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what's the plan for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure yet—what details do we have about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don't have any details yet either, but I can check with the organizer if you want.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, need a hand with that repair drive? I've got some tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks Sam, I could use an extra wrench. What've you got?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got a 10mm and a 12mm. Which one do you need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah, I've been hearing bits about a repair drive. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, um, repair drive? Sounds familiar. Maybe something about fixing up the community center?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: The community center? I've walked past it a few times—could use some love. Who's organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I heard from Mrs. Chen that it's legit, but you know how rumors go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're just taking Mrs. Chen's word for it? Have you seen any actual proof?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, have you heard anything about when the repair drive might be done?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, I haven't heard anything. I've been keeping to myself lately.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I've been asking around too. No one seems to know anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Is that happening this weekend? I keep forgetting the date.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it's this Saturday at 10 AM. Bring any broken tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Saturday at 10. Got it, I'll mark it down this time. Thanks, Leo!
